calibration: Frozen LightGBM+PROCESS isotonic calibration modestly improves mean Brier and ECE; no reselection occurred.
favorable_full_multimodality: Positive primary aggregate directions except the recorded Random Forest adverse directions.
limitations: Sprint 53 contains no T1 predictive evidence and cannot establish generalization.
ApacheJIT labels are benchmark-defined observed labels, not independently verified-clean ground truth.
The design evaluates 14 Apache projects within one benchmark family; external-benchmark generalization remains untested.
Project-level paired inference has limited power and cannot guarantee uniform project-level effects.
Development-selected best comparators can differ by project and algorithm and are frozen by PR-AUC, not MCC.
ECE depends on the frozen Sprint 51 binning policy and can be unstable under sparse support.
Ablation contrasts are predictive associations under late fusion, not causal modality effects.
Future XAI methods, stability thresholds, and reporting details require a separate prospective protocol.
T2 remains unavailable and provides no evidence in this sprint.
mixed_or_adverse: Random Forest is adverse versus best pairwise for PR-AUC/MCC and marginally adverse versus best unimodal for MCC.
what_t1_confirms: All frozen scopes retain measurable future-partition predictive evidence.
Full multimodality has favorable aggregate PR-AUC/MCC directions for most algorithms and frozen comparators.
The one-shot evidence is complete, traceable, and internally consistent.
what_t1_does_not_confirm: Uniform superiority of full multimodality across algorithms or projects.
External-benchmark generalization, causal modality effects, or verified-clean ground truth.
T2 performance or any XAI claim.
